scripts.android:emulator:dev: bash ./update-ip.sh android-emulator && ANDROID_SERIAL=emulator-5554 ENVFILE=.env.development react-native run-android --port=8082 --deviceId=emulator-5554
scripts.ios:dev: bash ./update-ip.sh ios-simulator && ENVFILE=.env.development python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.development react-native run-ios --scheme="Copy of TrailTasks" --port=8081 --extra-params="ENVFILE=.env.development"
scripts.ios:test: ENVFILE=.env.test python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.test react-native run-ios --scheme="Copy of TrailTasks" --extra-params="ENVFILE=.env.test"
scripts.ios:prod: ENVFILE=.env.production python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.production react-native run-ios --scheme=TrailTasks --mode=Release --extra-params="ENVFILE=.env.production"
scripts.ios:staging: ENVFILE=.env.staging python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.staging react-native run-ios --scheme="Copy of TrailTasks" --port=8081 --extra-params="ENVFILE=.env.staging"
scripts.build-ios-staging: ENVFILE=.env.staging python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.staging xcodebuild -workspace ios/TrailTasks.xcworkspace -scheme TrailTasks -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath ios/build/TrailTasks-staging.xcarchive ENVFILE=.env.staging clean archive
scripts.build-ios-prod: ENVFILE=.env.production python3 scripts/check-native-env.py && ENVFILE=.env.production xcodebuild -workspace ios/TrailTasks.xcworkspace -scheme TrailTasks -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath ios/build/TrailTasks-production.xcarchive ENVFILE=.env.production clean archive
scripts.test:env: node scripts/patch-rive-events.cjs --check && node --test scripts/*.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_native_env.py"
scripts.quality: npm run test:env && npm run test:unit
scripts.quality:release: npm run typecheck:release && npm run test:env && npm run test:unit
